hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -q -- '--amend' && echo 'BLOCKED: Never amend commits, create new ones instead' >&2 && exit 1; exit 0

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read file_path; if echo "$file_path" | grep -qE '\.py$'; then uv run ruff check --fix -q "$file_path" 2>/dev/null; uv run ruff format -q "$file_path" 2>/dev/null; fi; }
